title: Key Account Manager (Distribution) - Taste, East
description:
**Job Summary**

Looking for a role that challenges you while making an impact on products people use every day?

IFF is a global leader in flavors, fragrances, food ingredients and health & biosciences, we deliver sustainable innovations that elevate everyday products.

  

Taste: Crafting unique, technology-enabled flavor designs that define the identity of food and beverage brands, shape trends in flavor building and fuel market success.

  

The role is based in Kolkata, India (Hybrid role). Be part of a motivated, passionate, and open-minded team where together we can achieve greatness and make a real impact. Your potential is our inspiration.

  

**Where You’ll Make a Difference**

* Account Mapping - Targeting and Segmentation.
* Identify key stakeholders - Key Decision Maker/Key Opinion dealer across different accounts.
* Project Management - Proactive /Reactive/Defensive/Maintenance.
* Commercial Outcome - Growth Mindset.
* Work in close contact with IC&D for all projects and with category marketing for market insights & Growth initiatives.
* Partner with key stakeholders (CSMs/GPM/Pricing officer) to help implement pricing actions/improve margins as per organization’s strategies.
* Proper forecasting on a regular basis for seamless order execution.
* Drive healthy margin across portfolio.
100% compliance of company’s ethics/values /culture.  

  

**What Makes You the Right Fit**

* Bachelor’s degree in food technology, Food Science or MBA with experience in FMCG sector or relevant discipline.
* Minimum 2-4 years of sales or commercial experience in Food ingredients, Flavours, Food & Beverage Industry or FMCG sector.
* Experience with customers engagement and key account management.
* Good commercial and technical acumen that enables identification of technical and commercial needs, and proposal of optimized solution.
* Proactive and proven ability to work and manage time and priorities un-supervised.
* Effective listening, verbal and written communication, and presentation skills.
* Proven value selling and negotiation skills.
Willing to travel extensively.  

  

**How Would You Stand Out?**

* Demonstrated “can do” attitude, positive approach to problem solving.
Ablility to work independently and demonstrates respect for people.  

  

**Why Choose Us?**

* Multinational and supporting environment
* Health insurance
* Training opportunities
* Learning and development programs

We are a global leader in taste, scent, and nutrition, offering our customers a broader range of natural solutions and accelerating our growth strategy. At IFF, we believe that your uniqueness unleashes our potential. We value the diverse mosaic of the ethnicity, national origin, race, age, sex, or veteran status. We strive for an inclusive workplace that allows each of our colleagues to bring their authentic self to work regardless of their religion, gender identity & expression, sexual orientation, or disability.

Visit IFF.com/careers/workplace-diversity-and-inclusion to learn more

title: Manager Business Consulting - IT
description:
**Linde South Asia Services Pvt. Ltd. | Business Area: Information Services (IT)**  
**Manager Business Consulting - IT**  
**Kolkata, West Bengal, India | Working Scheme: On-Site | Job Type: Regular / Permanent / Unlimited / FTE | Reference Code: req33939**

It's about Being What's next.

**What's in it for you?**

The Manager Business Consulting will act as a business-facing IT partner by managing the application lifecycle and providing effective post-implementation support for Sales and Supply processes across the RSE region.  
  
At Linde, employees can enjoy a range of benefits that make the workplace comfortable and enjoyable. These include loyalty offers, annual leave, an on-site eatery, employee resource groups, and teams that provide support and foster a sense of community. These benefits demonstrate Linde's commitment to creating a positive work experience for its employees.
  
  
Every day is an opportunity: an opportunity to learn, to grow, to share success, and to contribute to one of the world’s leading industrial gas and engineering companies. Seize the opportunity: take your next step with us and join our team.  
  
Linde values diversity and recognizes the importance of fostering inclusion in our work environment. We believe that our success depends on the diverse perspectives of our employees, customers, and global markets. As an employer of choice, we strive to support our employees' growth, welcome new ideas, and respect our differences.

Team

Making an impact. **What will you do?**

* In this role you will participate as a core project team member in the implementation of SAP and non-SAP applications, including system interfaces, across the RSE region
* Further you will own the application development lifecycle for assigned initiatives by working with business users to gather and document requirements, translating them into SAP process designs, developing the functional specifications, configuring SAP solutions, collaborating closely with ABAP developers for custom developments, performing system testing, supporting user acceptance test and ensuring successful deployment
* Furthermore, you will identify process gaps and propose workarounds where required
* Moreover, you will provide end-to-end SAP application support for Sales and Supply systems across the relevant modules (e.g. SD, MM/PP/PM, Procurement, SAP authorisations, integrated FI/CO areas), including issue troubleshooting, user training, data cleansing and post go-live support
* Further you will maintain accurate and up-to-date system documentation, including business requirements, solution designs, configuration details and user/training manuals
* Moreover, you will act as a business process specialist by maintaining a strong understanding of Sales and Supply processes including OTC, PTP, R2R and master data management
* Additionally, you will collaborate with Global IT teams (including GIMS, BASIS, Release Management, TCOE, Global Business Consulting), Shared Services, regional and country IT teams, and external vendors to ensure successful project delivery and support

Winning in your role. **Do you have what it takes?**

* For this role you will have a degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, or other disciplines with strong interest in business consulting and a solid understanding of IT and business applications
* Further you have a minimum of three (3) years’ experience in system implementations, particularly in SAP SD
* Furthermore, you have a strong business knowledge and understanding of Sales and Supply processes
* Additionally, you have the ability to work in a global environment and travel as required

**Why you will love working for us!**

Linde is a leading global industrial gases and engineering company, operating in more than 100 countries worldwide. We live our mission of making our world more productive every day by providing high-quality solutions, technologies and services which are making our customers more successful and helping to sustain and protect our planet.  
  
On the 1st of April 2020, Linde India Limited and Praxair India Private Limited successfully formed a joint venture, LSAS Services Private Limited. This company will provide Operations and Management (O&M) services to both existing organizations, which will continue to operate separately. LSAS carries forward the commitment towards sustainable development, championed by both legacy organizations. It also takes ahead the tradition of the development of processes and technologies that have revolutionized the industrial gases industry, serving a variety of end markets including chemicals & refining, food & beverage, electronics, healthcare, manuf

At Linde, the sky is not the limit. If you’re looking to build a career where your work reaches beyond your job description and betters the people with whom you work, the communities we serve, and the world in which we all live, at Linde, your opportunities are limitless. Be Linde. Be Limitless.

Have we inspired you? **Let's talk about it!**  
  
We are looking forward to receiving your complete application (motivation letter, CV, certificates) via our online job market.

Any designations used of course apply to persons of all genders. The form of speech used here is for simplicity only.  
  
All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, protected veteran status, pregnancy, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other reason prohibited by applicable law.

The company is committed to technologies and products that unite the goals of customer value and sustainable development.

title: TC-CS-IAM-ISAM-Senior
description:
Location: Kolkata

Other locations: Primary Location Only

Salary: Competitive

Date: Oct 16, 2026

**Job description**
-------------------

Requisition ID: 1747271

At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.

  

**EY-Cyber Security-Senior IAM Consultant-ISAM**

As part of our EY-cyber security team, you shall Engage in Identity & Access Management projects in the capacity of execution of deliverables. An important part of your role will be to actively establish, maintain and strengthen internal and external relationships. You’ll also identify potential business opportunities for EY within existing engagements and escalate these as appropriate.

  

**The opportunity**

We’re looking for Security Consultant in the cyber security team to work on various Identity and Access Management projects for our customers across the globe. Also, the professional shall need to report any identified risks within engagements and share any issues and updates with senior members of the team.

In line with EY’s commitment to quality, you’ll confirm that work is of the highest quality as per EY’s quality standards and is reviewed by the next-level reviewer. As an influential member of the team, you’ll help to create a positive learning culture, coach and counsel junior team members and help them to develop.

As a member of the Identity and Access Management (IAM) team this position will contribute towards execution of an IAM roadmap that meets security requirements, including but not limited to security for customer applications using policy driven security, SSO, authentication and authorization, user provisioning/de-provisioning, and federation focusing on multiple protocols (SAML2.0, OpenID, OAuth2.0, WS-FED).

**Your key responsibilities**

* Engage and contribute to the Identity & Access Management projects
* Work effectively as a team member, sharing responsibility, providing support, maintaining communication and updating senior team members on progress
* Execute the engagement requirements, along with review of work by junior team members
* Help prepare reports and schedules that will be delivered to clients and other interested parties
* Develop and maintain productive working relationships with client personnel
* Build strong internal relationships within EY Consulting Services and with other services across the organization
* Help senior team members in performance reviews and contribute to performance feedback for staff/junior level team members
* Contribute to people related initiatives including recruiting and retaining IAM professionals
* Maintain an educational program to continually develop personal skills
* Understand and follow workplace policies and procedures
* Manage the performance management for the direct reportees, as per the organization policies
* Foster teamwork and lead by example
* Training and mentoring of project resources
* Participating in the organization-wide people initiatives

  

**Skills and attributes for success**

* Strong understanding of Identity Access Management solutions.
* Strong experience in designing and implementing Customer Identity and Access Management (CIAM) solutions, including customer registration, profile management, and self-service account capabilities.
* Knowledge of CIAM best practices, including customer lifecycle management, identity federation, consent management, privacy compliance, and secure customer onboarding.
* Hands-on experience on IBM Security Access Manager or IBM Security Verify Access end-to-end implementation involving requirement gathering, designing, implementation, customization and testing.
* Implementation experience in Web Module, Federation Module and Advance Access control module of IBAM/ISVA
* Hands-on experience with IBM ISAM WebSEAL administration, including configuration and management of various junction types, reverse proxy services.
* Experience implementing Single Sign on, Multi Factor Authentication, adaptive authentication, and customer/partner identity solutions using ISAM/ISVA.
* Working experience in application integration with header-based, SAML2.0, OIDC, OAuth2.0, WS-Fed protocols.
* Experience in implementing social login and third-party Identity Provider (IdP) integrations using ISAM/ISVA for secure authentication and federation use cases.
* Ability to design and customize authentication policies, access controls, identity workflows, and customer-facing access experiences.
* Experience in developing and integrating REST APIs, web services, and identity-related connectors to enable seamless customer and application integrations
* Ability to develop and maintain ISAM custom JavaScript mapping rules, API protection policies, and federation configurations.
* Proficiency in Java, JavaScript, and scripting technologies used for IAM customizations and automation.
* Experienced in diagnosing and resolving complex authentication, authorization, and federation issues.
* Experience in supporting platform administration activities, including upgrades, deployments, patching, and environment maintenance.
* Strong knowledge of certificate administration in ISAM, including troubleshooting SSL/TLS, signer, personal, and key database certificate-related issues.
* Understanding of IAM governance, configuration management, operational controls, and industry best practices.
* Willingness to work in a client-focused environment with flexibility to support evolving business and operational requirements.
* Should have knowledge of different integration and architecture in customer’s IAM environment such as Load Balancer, network components
* Understanding of latest technology such as Zero trust framework, Fine-grained authorization, Password less authentication, CIAM
* Ability to develop documentation such as business requirement document, high and low level design document, training and user procedures document.
* Should be flexible to work on new technologies in IAM domain.
* Should have had direct client experience, including working with client teams in an on-site or offshore mode.
* Need to liaise with Business stakeholders and seek requirement clarification. Should be able to map business requirements to technical specifications.

  

**To qualify for the role, you must have**

* B. Tech./ B.E. with sound technical skills
* Strong command on verbal and written English language.
* Relevant experience in IBM Security Access Manager or IBM Security Verify Access.
* Strong interpersonal and presentation skills.
* 6 – 9 Years’ Work Experience

  

**Certification:**

* Desirable to have certifications in security domain, such as CISSP and CISA or any IAM product specific certifications
* Desirable to have certifications in IBM Security Access Manager or IBM Security Verify Access

  

**What working at EY offers**

  

At EY, we’re dedicated to helping our clients, from start–ups to Fortune 500 companies — and the work we do with them is as varied as they are.

You get to work with inspiring and meaningful projects. Our focus is education and coaching alongside practical experience to ensure your personal development. We value our employees and you will be able to control your own development with an individual progression plan. You will quickly grow into a responsible role with challenging and stimulating assignments. Moreover, you will be part of an interdisciplinary environment that emphasizes high quality and knowledge exchange. Plus, we offer:

* Support, coaching and feedback from some of the most engaging colleagues around
* Opportunities to develop new skills and progress your career
* The freedom and flexibility to handle your role in a way that’s right for you

  

**EY | Building a better working world**

  

EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.

Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.

Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

* Ability to build and maintain relations with business units and continuously give feedback by stringent follow up on service legal agreements. Evidence of strong analytical, statistical and data mining skills to study trends, make projections and to interpret numeric information. Evidence of strong operational decision making and be able to provide support to the teams. Experience of successfully managing and developing a team/Individuals in previous role
* Evidence of process management skills with an ability to initiate & drive process improvements. Proven ability to initiate cost control measures by achieving resource efficiency and managing overheads. Will be expected to maintain HSBC internal control standards, including the timely implementation of internal and external audit points, together with any issues raised by external regulators.
* Must be aware of the operational risk scenarios associated with this role and act upon pertinent risk (if any). Responsible for the implementation of Group Compliance Policy as is applicable to this role. The role will require technical excellence to achieve target deliverables combined with the ability to get work done from administrators/SMEs to achieve target KPIs. The role will demand a daily balance of delivering an excellent client service within the standard model of promoting continuous improvement of processes and of identifying and capitalizing opportunities to create capacity and generate efficiencies
* Graduate/Postgraduate in commerce stream, MBA, MBA Finance. 10 years of relevant experience for an internal Candidate, 12 + years of experience for an external candidate. Must with strong knowledge of credit products in banking, post approval, lending docs, loan processing. Excellent verbal & written communication skills. Strong negotiation & persuasive skills. Compliance based on Grade complexity of loans managed by role is decided by global service delivery line management based on experience and performance. High level variation and specific manual processes required by Product/System/Client/jurisdiction

Ensure escalation process is in place and is effective. Be adherent to the audit standards of the group and compliant to all the policies and procedures. Driving awareness within team of any new policy, procedures or code that needs adherence.

title: Customer Experience Executive – Inbound Lead Qualification
description:
**About Duratuf**

We're an industrial safety company in Kolkata, with our own office and warehouse in Dubai  
Our equipment keeps workers safe at **4,142+ customers** across **65+ countries** — when it works, someone gets to go home to their family.  
We're on our way to **10,000 protected workplaces by 2035**

**About the Role**

* This seat sits at the front of the Customer Experience team and owns every inbound enquiry from the moment it lands.
* You qualify the enquiry, separate real buyers from noise, and hand clean opportunities to Sales.
* You cover all inbound channels during working hours: calls, WhatsApp Business, LiveChat, email and B2B platforms.

**Lead Qualification (Core of the Role)**

* Screen every inbound enquiry against MOQ, product feasibility and customer segment (distributor / EPC / end-user / OEM / government)
* Make correct qualify or reject decisions with minimal supervision
* Flag junk or irrelevant enquiries to the manager the same day and never pass them forward

**Multi-Channel Inbound Handling**

* Own all inbound touchpoints during working hours with zero missed enquiries
* Maintain First Response Time of 15 minutes or less on every channel
* Handle MOQ, price and product-fit questions without escalating every touchpoint

**Clean Handoff to Sales**

* Transfer every qualified lead with full context: company info, product interest, MOQ fit and conversation history

**CRM Hygiene**

* Log every enquiry and lead in Zoho CRM in the same session, tagged by stage
* Maintain 100% data completeness with zero pending updates beyond end of day
* Complete 100% of follow-ups within TAT

**Pipeline Reporting**

* Hold a weekly review with the Support Manager covering enquiries handled, response rate, qualification accuracy and conversion funnel

**What Success Looks Like**

* Zero missed inbound touchpoints
* First Response Time ≤ 15 minutes on every channel
* ≥ 90% lead-qualification accuracy
* 100% follow-up completion within TAT
* Every interaction logged in Zoho CRM the same session

**Requirements**

**Qualifications**

* Experience: 1–2 years in BPO (voice or chat), customer support, customer experience, inbound telecalling, inside sales or B2B enquiry handling
* Education: Graduate (any stream)
* Language: Fluent in English and Hindi, with the ability to understand Bengali
* Industry preference: B2B / Industrial / Manufacturing (PPE exposure preferred)

**Technical Skills**

* Familiarity with Zoho CRM, Zoho SalesIQ and WhatsApp Business (strong plus)
* Ability to manage multi-channel communication simultaneously
* Basic proficiency in Excel / Google Sheets
* Exposure to B2B trade platforms such as IndiaMART and TradeIndia (preferred)
* Exposure to any AI-based tool (nice to have)

**Functional Skills**

* Lead-qualification logic: knowing when to qualify and when to reject
* Composure and multitasking under load, with calls, chats and CRM updates running at once
* Process discipline: follows the SOP and qualification steps consistently and logs as you go
* Empathy, patience and professional phone and chat etiquette

**Values Fit (Non-Negotiable)**

* **Integrity:** pipeline data and follow-up logs reflect reality, with no inflated counts and no follow-ups marked done that weren't
* **Accountability:** owns FRT, follow-up completion and qualification accuracy as personal numbers, without being chased
* **Adaptability:** picks up new tools and products quickly and adapts to each customer rather than relying on fixed scripts

**Benefits**

* Flexible leave policy
* WFH and out-of-office opportunities based on requirements and conditions
* Performance incentives
* Performance recognition
* Dynamic career growth
* Statutory benefits as per industry standards
* Everything runs on Zoho One (modern, integrated tool stack)

Pay: ₹250,000.00 - ₹320,000.00 per year

### **Why Work at Lenovo**

We are Lenovo. We do what we say. We own what we do. We WOW our customers.

  
  

Lenovo is a US$83 billion revenue global technology powerhouse, ranked #153 in the Fortune Global 500, and serving millions of customers every day in 180 markets. Focused on a bold vision to deliver Smarter Technology for All, Lenovo has built on its success as the world’s largest PC company with a full-stack portfolio of AI-enabled, AI-ready, and AI-optimized devices (PCs, workstations, smartphones, tablets), infrastructure (server, storage, edge, high performance computing and software defined infrastructure), software, solutions, and services. Lenovo’s continued investment in world-changing innovation is building a more equitable, trustworthy, and smarter future for everyone, everywhere. Lenovo is listed on the Hong Kong stock exchange under Lenovo Group Limited (HKSE: 992) (ADR: LNVGY).

  

This transformation together with Lenovo’s world-changing innovation is building a more inclusive, trustworthy, and smarter future for everyone, everywhere. To find out more visit www.lenovo.com, and read about the latest news via our StoryHub.

### **Description and Requirements**

Lenovo is looking for an experienced **Regional Manager – LFR (Large Format Retail)** to drive the **its PC/ TAB /Accessories and Visuals SO** across the assigned region. The role will be responsible for achieving revenue and market-share objectives through effective retail execution, partner management, category development, and strong collaboration with internal and external stakeholders.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Drive **regional sales, revenue, market-share targets** for **PC/ TAB /Accessories and Visuals SO** through LFR channels.
* Develop and execute the **regional LFR sales strategy** aligned with Lenovo’s business objectives.
* Manage relationships with key LFR partners such as **Croma, Reliance Digital.**.
* Drive **sell-out**, inventory management, stock rotation and availability across the region.
* Build strong relationships with **regional and store-level business stakeholders**, ensuring effective execution of Lenovo’s product and promotional strategy.
* Lead **category expansion and product launches**, ensuring strong visibility and retail presence for Tablets and Accessories.
* Track and analyse **sales performance, market trends, competition, pricing, inventory, and retailer productivity** to identify growth opportunities.

title: Senior Territory Manager - Kolkata
description:
**At Elanco (NYSE: ELAN) – it all starts with animals!**

**As a global leader in animal health, we are dedicated to innovation and delivering products and services to prevent and treat disease in farm animals and pets.** **At Elanco, we are driven by our vision of Food and Companionship Enriching Life and our purpose – all to Go Beyond for Animals, Customers, Society and Our People.**

**At Elanco, we pride ourselves on fostering a diverse and inclusive work environment. We believe that diversity is the driving force behind innovation, creativity, and overall business success. Here, you’ll be part of a company that values and champions new ways of thinking, work with dynamic individuals, and acquire new skills and experiences that will propel your career to new heights.**

**Making animals’ lives better makes life better – join our team today!**

**Your Role: Territory Sales Manager - Pet Health**

As a Territory Sales Manager, you will be responsible for driving sales growth and strengthening Elanco’s presence in the assigned region by engaging with veterinary professionals, farm owners, and distributors. Your role will focus on building strong customer relationships, executing company strategies, and ensuring timely product movement and payment collection.

**Your Responsibilities:**

* Meet with veterinarians and other key customers to promote animal health products and generate profitable sales.
* Collaborate with distributors to drive product liquidation and encourage repeat purchasing.
* Follow up on outstanding payments from customers and distributors to ensure timely collections.
* Implement company strategies in the field, monitor competitor activity, and provide timely feedback.
* Achieve sales targets and maintain accurate records of customer and territory data.

**What You Need to Succeed (minimum qualifications):**

* **Education:** Bachelor’s degree in Veterinary Science, Animal Husbandry, Agriculture, or a related field.
* **Experience:** Prior experience in animal health or pharmaceutical sales, preferably in a territory-based role.
* **Top Skills:** Strong communication, relationship management, and sales execution skills.

**What Will Give You a Competitive Edge (preferred qualifications):**

* Strong understanding of the animal health market, including veterinary channels and livestock farming.
* Experience working with distributors and managing accounts receivable.
* Proven ability to meet sales targets and execute field strategies effectively.
* High levels of ethics, self-discipline, and accountability.
* Proficiency in reporting systems and Microsoft Office tools.

**Additional Information:**

* **Location:** Based in India – field-based role covering an assigned sales territory.
* **Travel:** Frequent travel required within the assigned region for customer engagement and distributor meetings.
* Must attend company meetings and training sessions as scheduled and comply with all company policies and reporting systems.

title: BC sector-p And u-ot-cs-Manager
description:
Location: Kolkata
Other locations: Primary Location Only
Salary: Competitive
Date: Sep 17, 2026
**Job description**
-------------------


Requisition ID: 1745035
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.

  


**GDS Consulting** – **Business Analyst/P\&U\-OT/Control Systems (ADMS, OMS, DERMS, AMI, SCADA) SMR – Manager/Senior**


**The opportunity**



We’re looking for SMRs at Manager/Senior rank with expertise in **Business Analysis/****Operational Technology/Control Systems (ADMS, OMS, DERMS, AMI, SCADA)**to join the P\&U Sector group of **GDS Consulting** **Team**. This is a fantastic opportunity to be part of a leading firm whilst being instrumental in the growth of a new service offering.

  


**Your key responsibilities**


* Analyse, understand and document client needs from a Business perspective and work with the client to arrive at optimal solutions leveraging the experience and expertise in OT/Control systems (ADMS, OMS, DERMS, AMI, SCADA)
* Identify and implement business process re\-design and continuous improvements, working closely with Clients, Operations teams, and other business areas
* Lead Project Scope Study workshops to understand the scope and key business requirements which must be met during the Execution phase
* Identify integration needs with any other in house/third party systems and provide detailed information about these systems to Solution Architects as well as Technical Team
* Act as an interface between Client Teams and Technical Team
* Explore opportunities for transformation and suggest ideas/recommend ways to transform the way the client works to be truly digital in the Digital Era to outperform competitors and gain advantage in the market
* Ability to assess Value Potential of a Transmission \& Distribution transformation program and ability to architect the value proposal
* Identify and develop commercialization solutions with substantial growth potential for  

power distribution clients, and provide advisory services to clients

  


**Skills and attributes for success**


* Strong understanding and experience with the electric utility industry, including knowledge of Grid Operations, Field Operations, Smart Grids and Digital Grid
* Deliver large/medium P\&U Sector specific solutions/OT (ADMS, OMS, DERMS, AMI, SCADA) as well as Control Systems
* Demonstrate expert core consulting skills and advanced level of OT/CS (ADMS, OMS, DERMS, AMI, SCADA) knowledge and industry expertise to support delivery to clients
* Understanding Distributed Energy Resources or related experience in clean energy, energy efficiency, storage and solar
* Perform an appropriate role in business development in terms of presales and practice development. for example, presales, internal engagement and / or knowledge management
* Experience working with clients throughout various parts of implementation lifecycle
* Proactive with Solution oriented mindset, ready to learn new technologies for Client requirements
* Programme management experience and track record of successful delivery of large, complex programmes
* Demonstrate people management and an ability to conduct and lead consultancy assignments
* Be result oriented as well as people focused
* Be able to manage a team, empathetic and work with Leadership for the development of the overall team

  

  

**Professionals in this role are expected to bring expertise in emerging technologies and advanced solutions that enable utilities to thrive in a digital, sustainable future. These include:**


* **AMI 2\.0 and Advanced Metering Infrastructure**: Next\-generation metering systems that go beyond traditional AMI, enabling real\-time data collection, advanced analytics, and integration with distributed energy resources for improved grid visibility and customer engagement.
* **Battery Energy Storage Systems (BESS)**: Knowledge of energy storage technologies and their role in grid stability, peak load management, and renewable integration. Ability to assess and design BESS solutions for operational efficiency and resilience.
* **Digital Twin Technologies:** Experience in creating virtual replicas of physical assets and systems to simulate, monitor, and optimise grid operations, predictive maintenance, and scenario planning.
* **Geographic Information Systems (GIS):** Proficiency in GIS platforms for spatial analysis, asset mapping, and network planning to enhance operational decision\-making and outage management.
* **System Integration and Architecture Design:** Capability to design robust integration frameworks and architectures that connect OT systems (ADMS, OMS, DERMS, SCADA) with IT platforms, ensuring seamless data flow and interoperability.
* **Smart Control Centre Solutions:** Expertise in modern control centre technologies that enable real\-time monitoring, automation, and advanced decision support for grid operations and distributed energy management.
* **Vegetation Management Tools and Strategies:** Familiarity with digital tools and predictive analytics for vegetation monitoring and clearance planning to reduce outage risks and improve reliability.

  


**To qualify for the role, you must have**


* Relevant experience in OT/CS (ADMS, OMS, DERMS, AMI, SCADA) Implementation /Technical advisory with total experience between 10 to 15 years (for Manager)
* Relevant experience in OT/CS (ADMS, OMS, DERMS, AMI, SCADA) Implementation/Technical advisory with total experience between 6 to 10 years (for Senior)
* Should be well versed with functional concepts of BA with relevant knowledge in OT/CS (ADMS, OMS, DERMS, AMI, SCADA) and Gap analysis
* Should be well conversant in OT/CS (ADMS, OMS, DERMS, AMI, SCADA), products/technologies, frameworks, business metadata management and relevant architectural components.
* Strong business analysis skills
* Strong command over business process design

  


**Ideally, you’ll also have**


* Good Business Writing skills
* Good Communication skills
* Maintaining end\-to\-end accountability and expectations for customer satisfaction and overall delivery excellence
* Prioritize deliveries in conjunction with implementation team
* Adopt a proactive, logical and organized approach to problem resolution
* Any relevant product/platform certification

  


**What we look for**


* The incumbent should be able to analyse and manage Business requirements for OT/CS (ADMS, OMS, DERMS, AMI, SCADA). Additional knowledge of Business Process Mapping and BPM tools will be an added advantage.
* An opportunity to be a part of Global, market\-leading, multi\-disciplinary team of 10000 \+ professionals, in the only integrated global transaction business worldwide.
* Opportunities to work with EY Consulting practices globally with leading businesses across a range of industries

  


**What working at EY offers**



At EY, we’re dedicated to helping our clients, from start–ups to Fortune 500 companies — and the work we do with them is as varied as they are.



You get to work with inspiring and meaningful projects. Our focus is education and coaching alongside practical experience to ensure your personal development. We value our employees and you will be able to control your own development with an individual progression plan. You will quickly grow into a responsible role with challenging and stimulating assignments. Moreover, you will be part of an interdisciplinary environment that emphasizes high quality and knowledge exchange. Plus, we offer:


* Support, coaching and feedback from some of the most engaging colleagues around
* Opportunities to develop new skills and progress your career
* The freedom and flexibility to handle your role in a way that’s right for you

  


**EY \| Building a better working world**

  

  

EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long\-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.

  

  

Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.

  

  

Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

title: Key Accounts Manager Poultry - Kolkata
description:
The Position


As a Key Account Manager, you will play a critical role in driving business growth by building strong, sustainable partnerships with key customers across your assigned territory. You will work closely with leadership, customers, and cross\-functional teams to create mutual value, achieve commercial objectives, and deliver business results in line with company strategy.


Duties \& Responsibilities


* Achieve sales and profitability targets across key accounts within both broiler and layer segments.
* Identify, pursue, and successfully close new business opportunities through the execution of BIAH’s Integrated KAM and Customer Business Planning (CBP) programs.
* Consistently seek opportunities to expand business with existing customers while winning new opportunities through strategic account management.
* Deliver short and mid\-term financial targets for your assigned customers and territory.
* Develop and maintain strong relationships with key stakeholders, decision\-makers, and management teams within customer accounts.
* Understand customer needs, challenges, and business priorities, and develop solutions that create value for both the customer and BIAH.
* Position BIAH as a trusted partner by identifying opportunities for collaboration and mutual growth.
* Lead the development of comprehensive customer solutions by combining BIAH products and services into compelling value propositions.
* Develop customer\-specific growth strategies based on market analysis, competitive insights, and customer objectives.
* Create and execute Key Account Business Plans aligned with local avian business strategies and organizational goals.
* Optimize account penetration and maximize share of wallet through strategic planning and execution.
* Build and lead effective key account teams to support account growth and opportunity success.
* Ensure clear communication, alignment, and successful execution of agreed account strategies.
* Collaborate with CX teams, Business Unit Managers, Area Business Managers, Business Service Heads, and other stakeholders to deliver customer success.
* Align budgets, investments, and resources with account opportunities to maximize return on investment.
* Provide accurate sales forecasts and business updates to support effective planning and decision\-making.
* Manage commercial agreements, pricing discussions, and receivables with assigned accounts.
* Identify mutual growth opportunities and contribute to performance planning and development discussions for team members.
* Regularly assess account potential, sales performance, market share, and growth opportunities by product segment and species.
* Gather and analyze market trends, customer insights, and competitive intelligence to strengthen business strategies.
* Maintain accurate and up\-to\-date customer information and activity records within the CRM system.
* Develop and execute comprehensive territory and account plans to drive sustainable growth.
* Maintain effective customer engagement through planned account interactions and agreed contact frequency.
* Utilize data, customer insights, and digital tools to prioritize opportunities and maximize business impact.
* Ensure all administrative responsibilities, reporting requirements, and customer records are completed accurately and on time.

* Customer focused
* Leadership competencies
* Performance and Return on Investment\-driven personality
* Knowledge of Animal Health Industry Economics
* Ability to work and thrive in matrix team environment
* Proven ability to work cross\-functional
* Interpersonal and communication skills
* Proven field experience of at least 8\-10 years
* History of successful performance.
* Good English in word and writing
* Proficiency in Excel, Word, Outlook and database applications.
* Ability to travel (may include overnight travel).
* Should reside in assigned geography or be willing to relocate.
